name: docker/compose/image
description: OCI image built from a Dockerfile, parameterized through compose.yaml (docker compose build)

registry.description: registry prefix for the image tag, no trailing slash; exported to steps as REGISTRY (compose.yaml interpolates it)

image.description: image name; exported to steps as IMAGE (compose.yaml interpolates it)

tag.description: image tag; exported to steps as TAG (compose.yaml interpolates it) — set it in smith.yml params or override per project

build.description: Build the image with docker compose build

push.description: Push the image with docker compose push
